description: Dordogne : Voiries intercommunales is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atd24.fr. Inventory of intercommunal roads of the community of communes of Vallée de l'homme, community of communes of the Pays Thibérien, community of communes Isle vern and Salembres, community of communes of Dronne and Belle in the Dordogne (24). Digitization of roads modeled on the road table of the IGN bdtopo. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Dordogne: Inter-municipal roads" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include route, intercommunale, dordogne, voirie, inspire. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
